name: jpmmatias
description: Agent skills by João Pedro Matias

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Teach a concept from first principles: mental models, annotated examples, diagrams and narrated motion scenes, with stateful courses that span sessions.

plugins.name: lesson-panel
plugins.description: Four-agent review for a learn lesson: an author writes it, then an expert, a novice, and a course-flow reviewer send notes back until all three approve.

plugins.name: curriculum-planner
plugins.description: Turn a course mission into the milestone map and ordered lesson list in assets/course.js, with a scene or lab decision per lesson, before any lesson is written.

plugins.name: source-researcher
plugins.description: Fill RESOURCES.md for a lesson with fetched, typed, annotated sources, so the author cites verified links and never invents a URL.

plugins.name: challenge-reviewer
plugins.description: Grade a learner's milestone challenge against the lesson's pass criteria, write the learning record, and mark the milestone mastered only when the work earns it.
